5. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that although the written information giving rise to the first information report was given on 11.09.2022, the said FIR reached the court of learned jurisdictional Judge only on Patna High Court CR.
Learned counsel further submits that in this case the police could not verify the age of the victim from the school where she claimed to have study up to class 5 and no age proof document was collected by the IO, but, at a belated stage, in course of trial, the prosecution brought one page of admission register, on which neither the school name is printed nor the same seems to be the first school admission register of the victim.
7. Learned counsel further submits that one school leaving certificate (Exhibit7/1) has been brought on record again at a belated stage, which would not be called in the category of the documents as envisaged under Section 94 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015.
In these circumstances, a mere opinion of the FSL that blood has been detected at place in the exhibit marked 'B' does not connect the appellant with the alleged occurrence.
Learned counsel has placed before this Court the evidence of the prosecution witnesses including the victim saying that the place of occurrence is said to be at a distance of one hour from the house of the victim.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
On 09.08.2022, the father of the appellant had given written complaint in the Panchayat and in the said written complaint, he has expressed his apprehension that he or his family member may be falsely implicated.
The Gram Panchayat had sent a notice to the father of the victim, but he did not turn up in the Panchayat.
It is, thus, submitted that it a case of false implication, in which the appellant, who has remained in jail for about three years would deserve suspension of sentence and release on bail.
It is submitted that the victim girl has supported the prosecution case and she has stated that this appellant had pulled her away to the bank of the river and there he had established physical relationship with with her.
